children: Greenbrier said it received orders for 3,400 railcars in its latest quarter, valued at an estimated $600 million.

Brian Comstock, executive vice president and president of The Americas who is slated to take over as Greenbrier's chief executive in January, said Tuesday that the orders demonstrate continued demand for the company's products, reinforcing its reach and providing a solid foundation as it enters its fiscal 2027.

The orders span a range of railcar types and end markets, Greenbrier said, including 780 railcars for the Saudi Arabian government-owned SAR that will support freight transportation capacity and infrastructure development in the country.
